accessNotes: No geo-block or JS gate encountered. /pricing is server-rendered HTML: every challenge card (117 cards = 9 products x 5-6 account sizes x 1-3 platforms) is present in the raw HTML with data-plan / data-account-size / data-platform attributes and explicit data-detail-key/data-detail-value pairs, so all figures below were read from the firm's own markup, not from a JS-rendered view. Two caveats: (1) Every card contains a hidden overlay 'Sorry, this product is not available in your region.' that JS un-hides for restricted geos - so some products may be unpurchasable from some countries even though they render for me. (2) Prices differ by trading platform: MetaTrader 5 and Match-Trade are priced identically; cTrader is priced differently (usually higher on small sizes, lower on some large sizes). ALL prices recorded below are the MetaTrader 5 / Match-Trade prices. (3) Two promo coupons were live at capture time: 'ETERNAL' (10% off) and 'OMO' (40% off OMO challenges). priceUsd below is the UNDISCOUNTED list price (the struck-through figure); priceWithCouponUsd is the advertised coupon price. (4) CONFLICT: the /pricing cards state Prediction Markets max loss 'Phase 1 5% / Funded 8%' for BOTH tiers, while /faqs states Essential = 3% trailing and Elite = 5% static. Because the firm's own two pages disagree, maxLossPct is left null for both Prediction products.
